name: Pop Pap Polters
original_name: ポップパップポルターズ
overview:
The remote control seems to have been moved. The sweets have disappeared without a trace... In fact, it may be the work of a mischievous ghost...

This lives within the walls of a certain house. Three little ghost brothers, Pop Pap Polters. A slightly strange story that will make you chuckle.
